smell_validity.evidence: Genuinely unreachable under any shipped configuration: two numeric guards sit below activation, a toggle stays false, statements follow the loop's break, and an estimator runs only through another dormant helper. Forced activation would crash the structure page on unanalyzed databases, cleanly separating this from conservative staged rollout; a strong, coherent example whose distributed fault is modest in consequence.

maintenance_impact.evidence: The scaffold makes ordinary maintenance error-prone: an executor function that can never run must stay because the application imports it, and edits to the structure or export views must reason through branches that never execute. Removal makes future work safer as well as shorter, though the burden is contained and removal is largely one-time cleanup.

development_plausibility.evidence: Dataset statistics readers, module-level formatters, commented protocol constants, and the gevent pool sizing all mirror existing conventions in the touched modules, and the misplaced runner lines read as a believable review slip. It feels repository-native, but four fully polished, simultaneously dormant features landing together carry faint artificial regularity short of genuine production evolution.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: It spells out each deadness mechanism and the affected areas, orders removal of supporting-only imports, constants and aliases, forbids enabling dormant paths, and explicitly protects live neighbors like row-key coding used by detail rows. It decisively blocks enablement misdirection, leftover-alias incompleteness and collateral redesign, turning a vague cleanup into a reliable execution contract.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Four distinct purposes are staged: the advisory panel behind a frozen constant, the export manifest with its transitive estimator chain, the failing-script bookkeeping after a break, and the pool toggle. Guard stripping, cross-module orphan tracing and control-flow reasoning require different decisions, though three clusters ultimately share the guard-removal decision type.

localization_burden.evidence: Areas are named but not sites: the solver must locate each frozen constant, follow the application-to-executor import chain exposing phantom wiring, and cover both duplicate import blocks. Constants decide which branches live, and plausible decoys need exclusion, such as live row-key coding also referenced by dead code and shared schema accessors still serving live screens.

repair_coordination.evidence: Deleting the executor helper must accompany both application import sites or startup dies on ImportError; removing a guard constant while keeping its branch would break live requests. Runner bookkeeping must be deleted rather than moved, else failing scripts return duplicated results. Rules interact through the orphan cascade so clusters cannot be edited independently.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Reference-based deletion finds nothing, since every injected helper is referenced from dead code, while the estimator hides behind a dormant consumer and its aliases. Stripping guards repairs just three branches; post-terminator cleanup only the runner pair. Multiple examined uniform approaches each leave most mechanisms untouched, so none reaches a fifth of the sites.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Moving the runner bookkeeping before the break passes successful scripts but silently appends a duplicated, mutated result only when a script fails; enabling the advisory breaks only never-analyzed databases. These are concrete hidden error-path and state-dependent failures, but no supplied test material establishes the unchecked second failure path a higher score needs.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
